start.title: Голос Свыше
start.text:
Бог говорит с вами.
«Сделай себе ковчег. Грядет потоп».

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Наблюдающий мир
mockery.text:
Мир вокруг вас развращен и полон насилия.
Они наблюдают, как вы строите. Как вы отвечаете?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Кипарис и смола
building.text:
Вы собираете материалы, которые повелел Бог.
Как вы строите ковчег?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Он стоит завершенный
ark_done.text:
Ковчег завершен, точно как повелел Бог.
Как он выглядит?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Приходят твари
animals.text:
Животные приходят к ковчегу.
Кого вы берете на борт?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: Дверь закрыта
boarding.text:
Пришло время войти в ковчег.
Кто входит, и кто закрывает дверь?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: На водах
inside.text:
Ковчег плывет по глубине.
Как долго воды преобладают на земле?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: Голубь возвращается
dove.text:
Воды начинают отступать.
Как вы узнаете, что суша близко?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Земля под ногами
dry_land.text:
Господь говорит вам выйти из ковчега.
Что вы делаете первым на суше?

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: Радуга
covenant.text:
Радуга простирается по небу.
«Никогда больше Я не затоплю землю. Это Мой завет с вами».
